result.description: API-first B2B customer support platform (Slack, Teams, Discord, email, in-app chat) with AI agent and workflows.
result.auth_detail: Machine user API keys sent as 'Authorization: Bearer plainApiKey_xxx' with fine-grained permissions; OAuth apps for calling the API as a workspace user.
result.access_detail: Pricing page: Foundation $45/user/month (billed annually), Horizon $99/user/month, Frontier custom. 7-day free trial, no credit card required. No permanent free tier found, so a developer needs a trial or paid workspace to get a working API key. API access does not appear to be plan-gated beyond that.
result.api_notes: Single GraphQL API. Plain's own app is built on it, so docs say there are no limitations on what can be done. Also a GraphQL SDK (TypeScript). Webhooks exist. I did not count endpoints.
result.blocker: No free tier: only a 7-day trial, then paid per-user plan. Otherwise self-serve API keys and OAuth apps work.

evidence.quote: A machine user can have several API keys, so you can rotate them without downtime.
Three plans for B2B support teams: Foundation at $45/user/month, Horizon at $99/user/month, and custom Frontier.
7-day free trial, no credit card required.
Plain itself is built on this same GraphQL API.
Connect Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client to your Plain workspace over the Model Context Protocol.
The MCP server uses the same auth.
